# 4-Day Lisbon Family Trip Plan

A relaxed Lisbon itinerary for 2 adults + 1 child, with one museum day, one beach/park day, and daily food kept under **EUR 90**. Dates fit **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-14** with arrival/departure buffer on the 10th and 14th.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Budget

### Day 1: Old Town Arrival + Easy Riverside Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and take a light start in **Baixa/Chiado**; use a taxi or rideshare from the airport to avoid stairs with luggage.
- Afternoon: Ride the **Santa Justa area**, then stroll to **Praça do Comércio** and the riverfront.
- Dinner: Simple family meal in Baixa or Chiado; choose a casual Portuguese café with kid-friendly staples.
- Backup indoor activity: **MUDE – Design and Fashion Museum** or a long café stop if the weather turns.
- Estimated cost: Local transit **EUR 15**, sightseeing **EUR 0-15**, food **EUR 70-85**, total **EUR 85-115**.

### Day 2: Museum Day in Belém
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Morning: Head to **Belém** for a museum-focused day; start with the **MAAT** or **National Coach Museum** depending on your child’s interest.
- Afternoon: Visit **Jerónimos Monastery exterior**, then enjoy **Pastéis de Belém** and a relaxed walk by the river.
- Dinner: Early dinner back near your hotel or in a neighborhood spot with pasta, grilled fish, or soup options.
- Backup indoor activity: Stay longer at **MAAT**, **Coach Museum**, or the **Berardo Collection Museum** if available.
- Estimated cost: Transit **EUR 12**, museum entries **EUR 20-35**, food **EUR 75-90**, total **EUR 107-137**.

### Day 3: Beach or Park Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Take a train to **Cascais** for a beach day, or choose **Monsanto Forest Park** if you want more shade and a lower-key outing.
- Afternoon: At Cascais, keep it easy with sand time, a promenade walk, and an ice cream break; at Monsanto, do a short nature walk and playground time.
- Dinner: Return to Lisbon for an early, inexpensive dinner near your accommodation.
- Backup indoor activity: **Cascais Museum Quarter** or a covered shopping center/café stop in Lisbon.
- Estimated cost: Transit **EUR 15-20**, beach/park extras **EUR 10-20**, food **EUR 70-85**, total **EUR 95-125**.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Estimated cost: Transit **EUR 15-20**, beach/park extras **EUR 10-20**, food **EUR 70-85**, total **EUR 95-125**, Lisbon, Portugal

### Day 4: Alfama, Tram Views, and Departure Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Explore **Alfama** slowly; keep the route short and use the tram or a taxi for uphill sections.
- Afternoon: Visit a viewpoint such as **Miradouro de Santa Luzia**, then pick up snacks and souvenirs.
- Dinner: If your flight is later, have a final casual meal; otherwise, keep it to airport food and an early transfer.
- Backup indoor activity: **Lisbon Story Centre** or **Fado Museum** for a quieter cultural fallback.
- Estimated cost: Transit **EUR 15**, activities **EUR 0-20**, food **EUR 50-90**, total **EUR 65-125**.

## Cost Plan for the Full Trip

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Accommodation | EUR 900-1,200 | Family room or apartment for 4 nights |
| Local transit | EUR 55-80 | Mix of metro, tram, train, and taxis |
| Food | EUR 280-360 | Kept near EUR 70-90 per day |
| Activities | EUR 60-140 | Museum entries, small extras, snacks |
| Buffer | EUR 200-300 | Taxis, treats, weather changes, extras |
| Total | EUR 1,495-2,080 | Within your EUR 2,400 cap |

## Family-Friendly Stay Strategy

- Stay in **Baixa, Chiado, or Avenida da Liberdade** for easy walking and simpler transit.
- Use **taxi/rideshare for airport transfers** and uphill segments; save the metro/tram for short, easy legs.
- Keep one **midday rest break** each day so the child does not get overtired.
- Book **one apartment or family room** with breakfast access if possible to protect the food budget.
